defaultContent.about:
What is TARODAN?

TARODAN is an online marketplace designed for diecast model car collectors in Turkey. It enables collectors to buy, sell, and trade safely.

Our Vision

To build Turkey's largest and most trusted diecast community.

Our Mission

To support the collector community with a fair, transparent, and secure marketplace.

Our Values

  • Trust: Transactions are protected.
  • Community: We bring collectors together.
  • Transparency: We use clear pricing.
  • Passion: We share a love of diecast models.

Contact

Visit our contact page with any questions.
defaultContent.faq:
General

What is TARODAN?

It is an online marketplace where diecast collectors can buy, sell, and trade products.

Is membership free?

Yes. Paid plans are also available for higher listing limits.

Shopping

How do I buy a product?

Add the product to your cart, enter your address, and complete secure payment.

Which payment methods are accepted?

Credit cards, debit cards, and virtual cards are accepted.

Selling

How do I create a listing?

Add photos, a description, and a price from the Create Listing page.

Trading

How does trading work?

You can make an offer with one of your products on listings open to trades.

Shipping and Security

Orders use tracked shipping. Personal data is protected under KVKK and GDPR requirements.
